  • Class
    Description
    Downloader
    The Downloader class represents a downloader that sends and receives messages to and from barrels.
    IndexStorageBarrel
    The `IndexStorageBarrel` class represents a barrel that stores and manages indexed data.
    RMIBarrelsInterface
    The RMIBarrelsInterface interface defines the methods that can be invoked remotely on a RMIBarrels object.
    RMIClient
    The RMIClient class represents a client that interacts with the RMIServer through RMI (Remote Method Invocation).
    RMIClientsInterface
    The RMIClientsInterface interface defines the methods that can be invoked by the server to notify clients.
    RMIGateway
    The RMIGateway class represents the gateway for the RMI-based search engine system.
    RMIGatewayBarrelsInterface
    The RMIGatewayBarrelsInterface interface defines the methods for interacting with the gateway for barrels in a distributed system using RMI.
    RMIGatewayClientsInterface
    The RMIGatewayClientsInterface interface defines the methods that can be invoked remotely on a RMIGatewayClients object.
    RMIGatewayDownloadersInterface
    The RMIGatewayDownloadersInterface is a remote interface that defines the methods for interacting with the gateway downloaders in a distributed system.
    URLData
    The URLData class represents the data associated with a URL in the downloader application.
